goal: Separate faster command/data opportunity from reductions in absolute DRAM timing delay.
design: Keep DRAM=1700MHz; double each elapsed-time DRAM-clock parameter from the 850MHz P0 (RCD/RAS/RP/RC/CL/WL/RRD/WR/CDLR/RTPL, bank-group CCDL where applicable), after auditing derived expressions and constraints. Keep core-clock fixed delays such as dram_latency=100 and L2 ROP unchanged. Keep geometry, mapping, request/return queues, scheduler and input fixed.
caveat: Do not blindly double nbk, nbkgrp or buswidth. Classify tCCD/CCDL and burst/data-command ratio explicitly: preserving all spacing in ns can also remove the intended throughput increase. State chosen sustained bandwidth and absolute-latency contract; this is not achieved by a single clock edit.
minimal_scope: One strided kernel/input chosen before seeing new performance, both CH and DH, paired with fresh instrumented baseline only if build changes; exact budget to approve after finished18.

goal: Test interaction between FIFO capacity and DRAM time-domain speed.
design: 2x2 of FIFO64/256 and850/1700MHz; existing P0/PQ/PS are three corners. Only after they close strict accepted, add joint corner for matched CH/DH using identical existing binary/config contract.
interaction_formula: I_cell=C_PQ*C_PS/(C_P0*C_PQPS); multiplicative independent speedups imply1. Compare I_DH/I_CH. No additive speedup assumption.
minimal_scope: A preregistered sentinel input (ATAX is informative if accepted PQ regression persists); two new model points CH/DH. Broaden only with new approval.

goal: Distinguish FIFO backpressure removal, scheduler waiting, return congestion, L2 replacement/reissue and DTC completion service.
design: Instrumentation-only build with counters for queue occupancy-cycle sums/high-water marks/full events; request UID+stage enqueue/dequeue timestamps for L2 miss/FIFO, dram-delay, FRFCFS, bank issue/data ready, return FIFO, DTC completion/retirement; per-kernel sums/counts/histograms. Bounded event sampling keyed by stable UID. Never change allocation/arbitration/admission.
qualification: CPU tests plus at least a matched reference run verifying exact cycles, instructions, CTA and traffic against uninstrumented binary before causal consumption. Capture source hash, observer overhead, RSS/output limits, cross-kernel draining and request-cohort accounting.
minimal_scope: One CH/DH sentinel pair at P0 and one discriminating perturbation; exact model-start budget requires new approval.
